headline: Interpretability Tools Recover Known Visual Selectivity in Neural Models
label: Interpretable Neural Encoding Models
summary: Preprints now apply LRP, feature visualization, and mechanistic tools to brain encoders and EEG foundation models, testing whether learned representations…
synthesis: The dominant thread is validation of machine learning models of neural activity against established neurophysiology. Two items build or benchmark models of neural data directly: a spatiotemporal TDANN with contrastive training reproduces macaque MT direction maps and pinwheel structure, and SpikeProphecy provides a causal autoregressive benchmark for spike-count forecasting across 105 Neuropixels sessions. Other items probe trained encoders or foundation models with attribution and visualization methods. Feature visualization recovers the V1-V4 hierarchy and FFA, MT, and PPA selectivity in TRIBE v2; mechanistic analysis localizes image features driving human visual cortex voxels with causal validation; and LRP on EEG transformers exposes ocular shortcuts in motor imagery alongside a central arousal signature. What is new is the use of these checks as discovery tools, including a closed-loop framework that converts digital-twin models of macaque V1 and V4 neurons into verifiable language descriptions of selectivity.
